description: Current wait to enter the US at a land border crossing: passenger car general lanes, SENTRI or NEXUS, Ready Lane, pedestrian and commercial truck (FAST) lanes, lanes open, port hours, CBP notices and when CBP last reported. Accepts a port or bridge name (San Ysidro, Otay Mesa, Peace Arch, Ambassador Bridge, Rainbow Bridge), the city across the border (Tijuana, Juarez, Nuevo Laredo, Windsor, Vancouver), a state, or a CBP port number.

crossing.description: Crossing, city across the border, US border state, or CBP port number.

name: border_wait_times
title: Border wait times at a crossing
